Alex (eng): Heads-up — hotfix PR #8321 touches the KV warmup path and needs two approvals before today's 18:00 UTC cutover. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8321 — small bounds-check change but affects allocation path. Aiming to merge by 17:30 UTC, can folks on release rotation take a quick look?
Maria G: On it, will run a quick local smoke and sanity check. ping me if you want a pairing session. :eyes:
Tyler H: I can review now. Any specific repro or smoke steps? Is this purely safety check or are there perf implications?
Alex (eng): Main change in runtime/kv_warmup.go — added bounds guard around prefetch logic. Smoke command: `./scripts/smoke.sh --kv-warmup` and run the small perf harness `go test ./bench/kv -run BenchmarkWarmup -bench .`
Jenna L: Quick glance — left one comment about a nil path for the warmup buffer. If that's legit we should fix before merge, but it's very small.
Sanjay R: I have the release pager until 16:00 UTC, so I can be the second sign-off if someone else approves. If you're pushing after 17:45 I'm out though.
Maria G: Smoke went green locally, no mem regressions observed in 5 runs. Left an inline note about a log level; otherwise looks fine. +1 from me.
Tyler H: Addressed Jenna's nil-check comment and pushed a tiny followup commit (fix: guard nil buffer). Ran the bench quickly — no meaningful perf hit. Approving now. :thumbsup:
Jenna L: Re-checked the followup, tests pass, no additional comments. +1 from me as well.
release-bot: deploy-schedule: hotfix window opens 18:00 UTC, cutover lock at 17:45 UTC. Reminder: only emergency fixes allowed after lock.
Alex (eng): Thanks — merging to `main` and queuing for canary. Will watch latencies for 30m post-canary.
Tyler H: Thanks Alex — will keep an eye on the canary dashboard and alert if anything off.
Sanjay R: Great, thanks folks. If canary looks good and you're still within window, please proceed to full rollout.
Alex (eng): Canary succeeded, rolling to 25% then 100%. All good so far, closing loop.
